digest.component_or_area: Close gate / disposition / ticket state machine
propositions: Operators resort to --force for administrative closes (duplicate, obsolete, wontfix, superseded) because no truthful exit exists in the completion-verification gate and the disposition path is not discoverable from error messages.

Non-bug ticket types (task, story, epic) cannot close via administrative disposition because close_precheck gates the path to bugs only, leaving no valid way to mark them complete when work is not the intent.
Obsolete and wontfix classes require a reason to close, but the --reason flag is today force-only and CLI refuses it on plain transitions, blocking administrative closes from capturing the rationale.

The close-precheck failure message enumerates only generic remediation guidance and never mentions the applicable --class values for the ticket type, leaving operators blind to the administrative path.

Administrative disposition closes must skip completion verification (AC, file-impact, billable checks) and instead return a signed attestation; reason-only classes need a new explicit precheck branch to route correctly.
Replacement-bearing classes (duplicate, superseded) must demand a live replacement link; reason-only classes (obsolete, wontfix) must demand a reason but not a link.
